resources.string: Sign in to your MediBook account.
Register as a patient to get started with MediBook.
Enter a valid phone number with 7–15 digits.
You are signed in to MediBook as a patient. Doctor browsing and appointments will be added in a later step.
Your administrator session is verified. Manage doctor details and availability. Appointment management will be added later.
Unable to verify your account online. Check your connection and sign in again.
Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
This password does not meet the account security requirements. Choose a stronger password.
This email is already registered. Use Login. If a previous profile setup failed, contact the hospital administrator.
Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, or contact the hospital administrator if your account is unavailable.
Email/password sign-in is unavailable. Contact the hospital administrator.
Your account profile could not be accessed. Contact the hospital administrator to check Firestore permissions.
Your account has no profile. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator to complete or repair account setup.
Your account profile is incomplete or invalid. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator.
Your account authorization and profile role do not match. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator.

Registration was not completed because the patient profile could not be saved. The new sign-in account was removed. Check your connection and ask the administrator to verify Firestore rules before registering again.

Registration was not completed. The patient profile could not be saved, and the new sign-in account could not be removed. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator before retrying with this email.
The request could not be completed. Please try again. If this continues, contact the hospital administrator.
View your hospital’s doctors and keep their details up to date.
Add, edit, deactivate or reactivate doctor records securely.
Active doctors can be viewed by signed-in patients. Deactivation hides a doctor from patients without deleting the record.
Tap Add Doctor to create the first doctor record.
Fetching doctor details from the server…
Use 0–999999.99, with a dot for decimals (for example, 500.00). Currency is not configured yet.
Inactive doctors are hidden from patients. You can reactivate them later.
All fields are required except biography. An internet connection is required to save. Wait for server confirmation before leaving.
This changes the doctor’s availability for patients. The doctor record will not be deleted.
Doctor added. Firestore confirmed the save.
Doctor updated. Firestore confirmed the save.
Doctor status updated. Firestore confirmed the change.
Updating doctor status. Waiting for server confirmation…
Saving doctor. Waiting for server confirmation…
Please wait for server confirmation. Logout remains available; it cannot undo a write already sent.
If the doctor exists, server details will replace this form’s unsaved entries. If a new doctor does not exist yet, the same ID will be reused on Save. No write is repeated automatically.
The operation could not be confirmed online. Check your connection and retry loading. After a save attempt, reload the doctor before saving again.
Doctor access was denied. Confirm your Admin session and ask the project owner to review the deployed Firestore rules. Local rule changes do not publish themselves.
This doctor no longer exists or could not be found. Return to the list and refresh.
This doctor changed since it was loaded. Reload the latest record before editing or changing status again.
A record already exists for this new doctor ID. Reload it to check the previous save; do not add a duplicate.
A doctor record has an unsupported format. Ask the project owner to review its fields, timestamps and integer fee format. No automatic repair is performed.
Your account session changed. Return to Login and verify your Admin account.
This screen or operation was interrupted, or server data could not be confirmed. Reload the doctor before saving. No write is repeated automatically.
The operation could not be confirmed. Reload the doctor or refresh the list before trying again.
Return to the doctor list without submitting these form changes? This does not undo a write already sent to Firestore.
Use no more than 100 characters for the name.
Use no more than 100 characters for the specialization.
Use no more than 200 characters for qualifications.
Enter a consultation fee. Use 0 for a free consultation.
Enter an amount from 0 to 999999.99, using a dot and no more than 2 decimal places.
Use no more than 1000 characters for the biography.
Remove control characters. Use a single line except in the biography.
Patients can read active schedules only while the doctor is active. Disabling a schedule retains its record. No appointment booking is implemented.
Active windows are checked before saving. Concurrent additions from another client may still overlap; strict prevention requires a trusted backend. This is not a booking guarantee.
An active schedule is visible to patients only while this doctor is also active.
This updates the saved weekly schedule in Firestore. The record will not be deleted and no appointments will be created.
Schedule added. Firestore confirmed the save.
Schedule updated. Firestore confirmed the save.
Schedule status updated. Firestore confirmed the change.
Add a weekly schedule for this doctor.
The selected doctor information is invalid. Return to Doctor Management and select the doctor again.
Fetching the doctor and weekly schedules from the server…
Checking active windows and saving. Waiting for Firestore confirmation…
Updating schedule status. Waiting for Firestore confirmation…
Please wait for server confirmation. Logout remains available but cannot undo a write already submitted.
An existing schedule will replace this form’s unsaved entries. If a new record is still absent, Save will reuse the same ID. No write is automatically repeated.
The operation could not be confirmed online. Check your connection and retry loading. After a save attempt, reload saved data before saving again.
Schedule access was denied. Verify your Admin session and ask the project owner to review deployed schedule rules. Local rule changes are not automatically published.
This schedule could not be found. Return to the schedule list and refresh.
The selected doctor no longer exists. Return to Doctor Management and refresh.
This schedule changed since it was loaded. Reload saved data before editing or changing status again.
This active window overlaps another active schedule for the same weekday. Change the day or times, or save it as inactive.
A record already exists for this new schedule ID. Reload it to check the previous save rather than adding a duplicate.
The doctor or schedule has an unsupported data format. Ask the project owner to review it. No automatic repair or conversion is performed.
Your account session changed. Return to Login and verify your Admin account.
This screen or operation was interrupted, or server data could not be confirmed. Reload saved data before saving. No write is automatically repeated.
The operation could not be confirmed. Reload saved data or refresh the list before trying again.
Use 5–180 minutes in 5-minute increments. A slot must fit within the time window.
Choose a day, two times on the same day and a slot duration. An internet connection and Firestore confirmation are required to save. No appointments are created.
Choose a day of the week.
End time must be later than start time on the same day. Overnight entries are not supported.
Enter the slot duration in minutes.
Use a whole number from 5 to 180 in 5-minute increments.
The slot duration cannot be longer than the time window.
Return without submitting these form changes? This does not undo a write already sent to Firestore.
